name: Carolina Cooks Foodservice Equipment & Supplies - Open To The Public
old_description: We understand that every business is unique. We take the time to understand your specific needs, from hoods to walk-ins, refrigeration to cooking equipment, smallwares to furniture.
about:
Carolina Cooks Foodservice Equipment & Supplies operates from Charlotte and Asheville, North Carolina. The company is family-owned and operated, though the founding year and founders' names are not publicly disclosed.

The company distributes a wide array of foodservice equipment and supplies, covering categories such as cooking equipment, refrigeration, dishwashing, beverage and bar, furniture, ice machines, plumbing, smallwares, storage, and tabletop. It also carries AllPoints Foodservice Parts & Supplies. Carolina Cooks collaborates with manufacturers so that warranties are processed directly through them, and its staff provides personalized consultation to help customers specify everything from ventilation hoods to walk-in coolers. No facility square footage, headcount, or annual sales volumes are disclosed.

The firm serves restaurants, hotels, bars, schools, clinics, and nursing homes, and its showroom and sales are open to the public as well.

Carolina Cooks differentiates itself through personalized service, taking time to understand each business's unique needs, and offers bilingual support in English and Spanish.
type_evidence: We offer a diverse selection of high-quality equipment. We collaborate closely with manufacturers who stand behind their products, ensuring warranties are handled directly through them.
